messages:
maria: Hey folks — automated incident posts are appearing in #prod-incidents but PagerDuty pages didn't go out for the last ~20m. Anyone else seeing missing pages? :thinking:

support-lead: I saw the incident banner in the console but didn't get a page. We've got a few customer tickets asking why support didn't respond quicker.

sre-oncall: I didn't receive a page either. Checking pagerbridge and notify-proxy logs now.

devops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-12345 -> routed to prod-oncall. Webhook delivered to /hooks/pagerbridge -> 200 OK at 16:22:03 UTC.

jonathan: running quick curl against pagerbridge shows 502 from notify-proxy: `curl -v -X POST https://notify-proxy.internal/hooks/abcd` -> upstream read timeout / 502.

maria: Logs show the X-Pager-Recipients header is being stripped/truncated on requests that previously succeeded. Looks like header content becomes empty before reaching pagerbridge.

kate: Can we page manually while we triage? Support needs confirmation to tell customers.

sre-oncall: Triggered manual PagerDuty incident and SMS for the 3 affected customers, also called oncall phone. Manual mitigations in place.

devops-bot: Replayed webhook payload to fallback endpoint https://pagerbridge-secondary.internal/hooks/abcd -> 200 OK, pager deliveries observed.

maria: Ok fallback works and pages went out. Root cause?

jonathan: Found a recent nginx config change in notify-proxy from last night where `large_client_header_buffers` and `proxy_buffer_size` were reduced. When header size > configured buffer, nginx silently truncates certain headers — our X-Pager-Recipients header (long list) got dropped. Reproduced locally by sending long header.

support-lead: Timeline: customers first saw delayed responses ~16:20 UTC, support notified them at 16:47 UTC after manual pages. Impact: delayed paging for 15–30m; no actual data plane outage reported, just slower incident triage.

sre-oncall: Rolling back the nginx buffer change on notify-proxy now and doing a controlled restart of the proxy pods.

devops-bot: notify-proxy config rollback applied, rolling restart started.

pagerbridge-bot: Test page sent through primary path at 16:50:42 UTC. Delivery: success.

sre-oncall: Confirmed receipt of test page on oncall device. Primary path restored.

maria: Actions: 1) revert config (jonathan) — done; 2) add automated healthcheck to detect webhook->pager failures (devops-bot); 3) add alert if pages aren't seen within 3m of incident creation (devops-bot); 4) update runbook to include manual-fallback steps and customer comms (support-lead).

kate: Also suggest metric for header size distribution and a test that replays large-header payloads on deploy. I'll add that to runbook.

support-lead: Drafted short customer note and updated internal triage checklist.

maria: I'll file the postmortem and owner assignments: jonathan -> fix proxy config and add integration test, devops-bot -> add healthcheck + alert, support-lead -> comms + runbook update.

sre-oncall: Closing incident: primary paging path restored, manual mitigations completed, customers notified. Will follow up in postmortem with timeline and preventative measures. :white_check_mark:
